summary: Device/config object selector: matches the input integer a2 against the stored values of 36 pre-registered global config objects (collision, audio, rendering constants) and, on a match, stores the address of the matched global into this[8] (this+0x20). Sets this[0] to 2 (matched) or 0 (no match), reinitializes the this+1 sub-structure via SwapAndReinit, clears this[7] (this+0x1C), and returns 0 on a match or -1 when no global matched. Called by ShortComputation_30a0 (0x004530A0).

local_names.a2: input device/config ID value compared against the stored values of the 36 global objects
local_names.v3: result code: 0 when a global matched, -1 when none did
local_names.this[0]: match-result status word: preset to 2, cleared to 0 when no global matches
local_names.this[7]: dword at this+0x1C, zeroed after SwapAndReinit
local_names.this[8]: dword at this+0x20 holding the address of the matched global config object

operations.description: Preset this[0] = 2 as the matched status before dispatch.

Compare a2 in sequence against the stored values of 36 pre-registered global objects (dword_7CA490, dword_7CCA44, dword_7CA3E8, dword_7CA470, dword_7CD198, dword_7CA3C8, dword_7CCBB0, dword_7CCFB0, dword_7CCA6C, dword_7CCF80, dword_7CCCB0, dword_7CCA7C, dword_7CD148, dword_7CCFDC, dword_7CD108, dword_7CD188, dword_7CA3B8, dword_7CC9BC, dword_7CD158, dword_7CA50C, dword_7CD0F8, dword_7CA438, dword_7CA448, dword_7CCBF4, dword_7CA3A8, dword_7CA480, dword_7CC9EC, dword_7CA3D8, dword_7CCF90, dword_7CCF60, dword_7CCF70, dword_7CCFA0, dword_7CA4F8, dword_7CA57C, dword_7CA410, dword_7CA4D0) and stop at the first equal one.
On a match, store the address of the matched global into this[8] (this+0x20).
If no global value equals a2, set this[8] = 0, clear this[0] to 0 and set v3 = -1.
Reinitialize the sub-structure at this + 1 via SwapAndReinit(this + 1, 89, 0).
Clear this[7] (the dword at this+0x1C) to 0 after the sub-structure reinit.
Return v3: 0 when a global matched, -1 when the input a2 matched none of the 38 registered objects.
This selector is invoked by ShortComputation_30a0 (0x004530A0), which feeds the selected config/device pointer into the device initialization flow.
